statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (h : ℕ) (θ : ℝ), ((‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range h, E (2*(j:ℝ)*θ)‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range h, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range h, E (2*((i:ℝ)-(j:ℝ))*θ)

plain_statement.zh: Fejér 核的平方等于差变量双和：‖∑ᵢE(2iθ)‖² = ∑ᵢⱼE(2(i−j)θ)。
plain_statement.en: The Fejér kernel square equals a two-variable difference sum: ‖∑ᵢE(2iθ)‖² = ∑ᵢⱼE(2(i−j)θ).

brief.zh: 用 ‖z‖² = z·conj z、conj(E x) = E(−x)、E x·E y = E(x+y) 三项展开，是角胞 L⁴ 交叉项的纯代数一步。仍缺：交叉项在宽弧之外的积分估计。
brief.en: Expand with ‖z‖² = z·conj z, conj(E x) = E(−x) and E x·E y = E(x+y); this is the purely algebraic step behind the L⁴ cross terms. Still missing: the estimate of those cross terms off the wide arcs.
